_about: Layer 2 (product line), layer 3 (family) and layer 4 (series) of the Meraki rows in the meraki category; reviewed in layers round 3 (15 Sep 2026). One product line per Meraki product a buyer names, as switches holds 'Meraki MS' and wireless 'Meraki MR Access Points': MV smart cameras, MX security and SD-WAN appliances, Z teleworker gateways, MG cellular gateways, MT sensors. The series are Cisco's model series ('MV63 Series', 'MG21/21E'). The rows come from Meraki documentation pages, so many are bare model names ('Cisco MV63'); page tokens (firmware versions, MCS indexes, cut-off teasers, PID fragments, misprints) and bare placeholders with no document or fact carry class plans, and the Meraki MR / Catalyst Wireless access points carry move plans to wireless (decision pending: Meraki MR / CW home, recommendation wireless by the Meraki MS precedent, run #1061). The MV camera generations are families: Cisco's documents name 'Second Generation MV Cameras' and 'Third-generation MV cameras' with their models (decision pending: generations as families, as ISR G1 / G2 in routers).

series.note: family from Cisco's documents: the MV Smart Camera FAQ lists 'All second-generation MV cameras (MV12, MV2, MV22(x), MV32, MV52, MV72(x))' and the MT FAQ 'Gen2: MV2, MV12(W/WE/N), MV22(X), MV32, MV72(X)'; the datasheet is titled 'Second Generation MV Cameras: Datasheet' (decision pending: generations as families)

family from Cisco's documents: the MV Smart Camera FAQ names 'Third-generation MV cameras (MV13, MV33, MV63(x), MV93(x)', the MT FAQ 'Gen3: MV13/M, MV23M/X, MV33/M, MV63/M/X, MV73M/X, MV93/M/X', and the accessories page mounts 'for Third-Gen MV'; the bare MV13 / MV13M rows carry class plans (family placeholders of MV13-HW / MV13M-HW)

lines.no_family_reason: MV21 and MV71 (the FAQ says 'Gen 1 cameras' without listing them on the documents held) and the MV44X, MV53X and MV84X are named in Cisco's documents without a generation
Cisco names each MG model with its external-antenna E variant ('MG21/21E Datasheet', 'MG41/41E Datasheet', 'MG51/51E', 'MG52/52E Technical Specifications') directly under MG, with no family between
Cisco names each MT sensor by model and function ('MT10 Datasheet - Temperature and Humidity', 'MT40 Datasheet - Smart Power Controller') directly under MT, with no family between
